description: This file contains unit tests for the CritterIconRenderer component in the OpenClaw project. It tests the icon rendering with different parameters, including size and badge rendering, and exercises helper functions related to critter status labeling.

classes.name: CritterIconRendererTests
classes.description: A struct containing test methods for verifying the behavior of CritterIconRenderer functions.

methods.name: make icon renders expected size
methods.description: Tests that the icon generated with default parameters has the expected size and representation.

methods.name: make icon renders with badge
methods.description: Tests that the icon can be rendered with a badge overlay.

methods.name: critter status label exercises helpers
methods.description: Asynchronously exercises the critter status label-related helper functions for testing.
